structures.name: Pineal Body
structures.about: The small midline gland on the roof of the diencephalon, just rostral to the superior colliculi. It secretes melatonin and tracks the light cycle.

structures.name: Superior Colliculus
structures.about: The rostral pair of rounded swellings on the roof of the midbrain, involved in visual reflexes and orienting the eyes and head.

structures.name: Inferior Colliculus
structures.about: The caudal pair of rounded swellings on the roof of the midbrain, a relay in the ascending auditory pathway.
